dependency_analysis.justification: Ghidra get_function_callees for 0x005a2010 returns an empty set and the raw body contains no E8/E9/FF call or jump opcode. The function is a leaf that only moves words between its own receiver and its stack arguments, so no opaque port table is needed and no external body is linked.
dependency_analysis.opaque_ports_if_dependency_appeared: A dependency would be modelled as a thiscall function-pointer port in the package header, defaulted to a null slot, with no body copied in. No such port was needed.

field_contract.branch_shape: single JZ at 0x005a2034 taken when the low byte of also_previous is zero; no other control flow
field_contract.write_order_note: the +0x80 row is written unconditionally before the guard is evaluated, and the mirrored +0x74 row is written afterwards
field_contract.gate_semantics: The gate reads one byte at ESP+0x10, so a nonzero upper half with a zero low byte (0x00000100, 0xff000000) skips the mirrored row. A full-word test would be observably wrong here.
field_contract.store_granularity: each of the six words is a 32-bit move; no byte or halfword store appears

null_and_sentinel_behavior.also_previous_zero: only +0x80/+0x84/+0x88 are written; the +0x74/+0x78/+0x7c row keeps its previous contents
null_and_sentinel_behavior.also_previous_zero_with_upper_bits: 0x00000100 also skips the mirrored row because only the low byte is read
null_and_sentinel_behavior.self_null: not guarded; native behavior is an invalid dereference at 0x005a2022
null_and_sentinel_behavior.fifth_stack_word: never read; the body contains no access above ESP+0x10

editor_gameplay_boundary.boundary_rule: The target ends at the POP ESI / RET 0x10 pair; nothing downstream is modelled.
